question: Does coarse spatial context improve a query-key similarity ranking of source-memory tiles against the exact source-local tile-removal effects?
scope: Four existing outcome-selected SAM2 reads from the prior signed-feature diagnostic; 16 fixed tiles per read. Descriptive only. No fitting, policy, token removal, new prediction trajectory, or efficacy claim.
source: CMSA-Net motivates multiscale context only. This is not CMA: its learned pyramid features, weights and operations are not transferable to SAM2 memory. Reuse SAM2's native first-layer Q/K projections and PyTorch pooling.

algorithm.matching: Native pre-RoPE Q/K projections at corresponding 64x64 coordinates; includes positions as supplied to the native projections. Compute per-position cosine similarity; zero norm gives zero. This aligned-location score is not native full attention and can miss motion.
algorithm.local: Mean cosine per one of sixteen fixed 16x16 tiles.
algorithm.coarse: Average-pool Q and K separately at scales 2 and 4 in projected pre-RoPE space; cosine at pooled cells; upsample nearest to original grid and average per tile.
algorithm.multiscale: Unweighted mean of within-read mid-ranks of local, scale-2 and scale-4 tile scores; ties get average ranks. Fixed before outcomes are evaluated.
algorithm.generic_control: Native layer-0 attention mass per tile, computed from post-RoPE Q/K softmax over all spatial memories and pointer keys, averaged over queries and heads; chunked exact softmax.
algorithm.random_control: Exact uniform average over all sixteen tiles, no random draws.
algorithm.utility: Native target Dice minus Dice after removing this source tile; positive means removal worsened Dice. Utility is an evaluation label, never a score input.
algorithm.metrics: Within-read Spearman correlation and lower-score selected removal utility minus exact uniform mean; ties averaged. Scores should be high for helpful groups, so choose the lowest-scoring tile for the diagnostic only.
algorithm.ties: When all score or utility values are constant Spearman is undefined and recorded as null. No GT-empty target is evaluated here.

controls: Compare local vs fixed equal-weight multiscale on identical 16 tiles, plus native attention and exact uniform; per-pair values and equal-pair descriptive means, no pooled-tile confidence intervals.
checks: Prior capture and utility receipts independently hash-validated
Capture/native replay raw decoder outputs equal
Native queries, positions, memory and pointers unmodified
Every source span and target ID matches prior utility
source/checkpoint hashes and exact fresh-process repeated results
no post-prompt GT input to descriptor or replay
limitations: Four post-hoc selected pairs, not representative or independent; cannot establish selector utility or efficacy
Coarse descriptors are pooled representations of a single SAM2 memory scale, not original multi-scale encoder maps or CMSA's learned CMA
Spatially aligned similarity can fail under motion
Utility is conditional on fixed history, grouped deletion, and attention renormalization
No absent-frame safety, training, deployment or full-video result
output_policy: Only a new directory under mounted Drive AdeSEG/outputs/experiment; preserve all prior receipts and outputs.
